title: Tannhäuser: Overture
notable_excerpt: Own MIDI render 0.00–15.00s; opening melody / theme
video_use_ideas: Introduce a long-term conviction message with the Pilgrims theme.
legal_notes: Wagner composition public domain (d.1883; opera published in the nineteenth century). Piano adaptation after Johannes Doebber (d.1921) and Franz Liszt (d.1886); source credits circa 1911 / 1848 arrangements. Downloaded from Artform, whose Wagner score page explicitly labels each listed score public domain. Matched PDMX per-file metadata records CC0 with license_conflict=False; no conflicting rights text in the MXL. Original MuseScore page currently returns HTTP 403; no files downloaded from MuseScore.com. PDMX dataset-level CC BY 4.0 notice is distinct from the source score’s per-file CC0 dedication; credit for consulted metadata: Long, Novack, Berg-Kirkpatrick and McAuley, PDMX, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15571083. Only Artform’s independently labelled PD score is redistributed here. Preview is an own FluidSynth render (FluidR3_GM), 15 seconds with fades and loudness normalisation; no third-party recording used.
licence_meaning: PD / CC0 / PDM / US-gov recording and score. Commercial use, no credit needed (courtesy credit still listed where the source asks).
